decisions.reason: The metro data centre connection network builds directly on the firm's owned fibre and carrier-neutral data centre footprint, and its documented adoption by financial and data centre customers gives the firm results it can learn from and expand.
Optical spectrum connectivity extends the firm's core fibre engineering knowledge into the high-bandwidth services named in its strategic direction, so it can interpret and improve the product well.
The number ordering portal uses the firm's software platform and regulatory know-how to support real-time provisioning, which fits its existing capabilities.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy, regulation-driven service in a market that has kept shrinking since 2019, so its resources are better spent on software-defined and cloud connectivity, where the firm's knowledge base is growing.
Direct voice network connection builds on the firm's established voice infrastructure and enterprise customer base, and it stays relevant as enterprises move to cloud and IP-based telephony.
